findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_proposal_status" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_template, get_proposal_status · Private data: get_capabilities, create_hcmotion, get_template, get_recreation_brief · Public sink: get_recreation_brief, propose_template, publish_template · Destructive: create_hcmotion, get_template, validate_json, get_recreation_brief, propose_template.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_template, get_proposal_status · Private data: get_capabilities, create_hcmotion, get_template, get_recreation_brief · Public sink: get_recreation_brief, propose_template, publish_template · Destructive: create_hcmotion, get_template, validate_json, get_recreation_brief, propose_template

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_capabilities" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
